name: 13096-multilora-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. 13.5 GB of fp16 weights plus four rank-8 adapters fit one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, MHA 32 heads over 32 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, fp16, 6.74B params = 13.5 GB; KV is 512 KiB/token.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 2048 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 30% by completion. 256 is inside the engine's resolved seq cap of 1024; moving it down un-saturates the loop and changes what is being measured.
workload: guidellm `parquet_file`, configs/data/sharegpt-llama2-2048.parquet: 2048 rows of (prompt, output_tokens_count), single turn, streaming, no chat template. They are real ShareGPT chat turns with the Llama-2 token length of the reply as the output length -- prompts mean 253.3, max 1024; outputs mean 239.5, median 163.5, p99 973, max 1612. EVERY REQUEST CARRIES AN ADAPTER, drawn uniformly at random from four names declared client-side in scenario.json `spec.backend.lora_modules`. Every request emits exactly its declared length: the backend forces ignore_eos=True whenever max_tokens is set. Prompts go on the wire as raw text (`request_format: plain`); the checkpoint ships no chat template.
purpose: A four-persona chat assistant on a 7B model with LoRA adapters, serving 256 concurrent streaming conversations on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 13096-multilora-7b-1gpu. Flat `key: value` only: an indented line is skipped,
# so a structured value must stay on ONE line or the key is silently dropped.
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 4
max-lora-rank: 8

# LOAD-BEARING: on this engine `enable_prefix_caching` defaults to `bool(VLLM_USE_V1)`, i.e. ON,
# and the workload replays a fixed pool of prompts, so a cache would change the request shape.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Both written out because the resolved value is path- and environment-dependent, and a silent
# max_num_seqs of 256 would sit exactly on top of the declared 256 streams.
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 1024

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
